description: Submission of the Parliamentary Pensions Law (Repeal) Bill for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2025‑06‑16 to repeal the Parliamentary Pensions Law, No.1 of 1977 of the National State Assembly. As per the pledge made by the Government to all Sri Lankans who supported its vision stated in the Government manifesto, ‘A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life’, a Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman to repeal the Parliamentary Pensions Law, with the aim of abolishing the pension entitlements granted to the representatives elected to Parliament and their spouses. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
